reason: Integrated the observation-only DriverProfile capability into UX-ROM using documented signed-driver package, Plug and Play health, and exact driver-service interfaces. The profiler enforces provider-schema checks, 20-second CIM timeouts, a default 512-record limit, capture-local salted device hashes, omission of device names and identifiers, complete observer calibration, Layer 4 workflow routing, and single full-diagnostics integration. The final passive lab run recorded 250 device-package rows, 126 grouped package identities, 17 provider labels, zero nonzero PnP error codes, and 89 successful exact service lookups. Three calibrated runs measured 8205.287 ms median and 8920.123 ms p95. No driver package, device, service, OEM component, or Windows state changed, and no driver-overhead, update, or performance-gain claim was made.
